why_it_matters.text: A sleep medicine sold as Dayvigo, one of the orexin blockers that switch off the brain's wakefulness signal rather than sedating the whole brain.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under NDA 212028 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
